claims: The Dolby Theatre in Hollywood is the permanent home of the Academy Awards since 2002.
The Dolby Theatre is located at Ovation Hollywood (formerly Hollywood & Highland).
The Dolby Theatre has 3,400 seats for the Oscars.
The Dolby Theatre has approximately 1,600 seats for typical performances or screenings.
The Dolby Theatre features a stage that is 120 feet wide x 75 feet deep.
The Dolby Theatre features Dolby Atmos audio.
The Dolby Theatre features Dolby Vision projection.
The Dolby Theatre is located at 6801 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA.
The Dolby Theatre is within Ovation Hollywood.
The Dolby Theatre hosts the Oscars.
Guided walking tours are available at the Dolby Theatre.
Specific events like the Oscars at the Dolby Theatre are strictly formal or black tie.
There is no formal dress code for regular public tours or shows at the Dolby Theatre.
